# System Architecture Diagrams Collection

This directory contains comprehensive system architecture diagrams created specifically for showcasing Nest Tech Solutions' technical expertise and project capabilities. All diagrams are professionally designed with consistent branding and detailed technical accuracy.

## 🏗️ Architecture Diagrams Collection

### 1. **Microservices Architecture** (`architecture-microservices.svg`)
- **Purpose**: Enterprise-scale microservices system design
- **Features**: 
  - Service discovery and API gateway
  - Independent microservices with dedicated databases
  - Message queue integration (Kafka)
  - Monitoring and observability stack
  - Load balancing and auto-scaling
- **Technologies**: Node.js, Python, Java, Go, Scala, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Redis, Kafka
- **Use Cases**: E-commerce platforms, SaaS applications, enterprise systems

### 2. **Serverless Architecture** (`architecture-serverless.svg`)
- **Purpose**: AWS-based serverless application architecture
- **Features**:
  - AWS Lambda functions with multiple runtimes
  - Event-driven architecture with EventBridge, SQS, SNS
  - Managed services (DynamoDB, RDS Aurora, S3)
  - API Gateway and CloudFront CDN
  - Step Functions for workflow orchestration
- **Technologies**: AWS Lambda, DynamoDB, S3, API Gateway, CloudWatch
- **Use Cases**: Web applications, mobile backends, data processing pipelines

### 3. **Kubernetes Container Orchestration** (`architecture-kubernetes.svg`)
- **Purpose**: Container orchestration at scale
- **Features**:
  - Multi-node Kubernetes cluster
  - Pod deployment across worker nodes
  - Service mesh and networking
  - Persistent storage and StatefulSets
  - Horizontal Pod Autoscaling (HPA)
  - Resource monitoring and management
- **Technologies**: Kubernetes, Docker, Helm, Prometheus, Grafana
- **Use Cases**: Containerized applications, microservices deployment, CI/CD

### 4. **Event-Driven Architecture** (`architecture-event-driven.svg`)
- **Purpose**: Scalable event-driven system design
- **Features**:
  - Apache Kafka event streaming platform
  - Multiple event producers and consumers
  - Stream processing with Apache Flink
  - Event sourcing and CQRS patterns
  - Real-time analytics and notifications
- **Technologies**: Kafka, Apache Flink, EventStore, RabbitMQ, Redis
- **Use Cases**: Real-time analytics, IoT systems, financial trading platforms

### 5. **Clean Architecture (Hexagonal)** (`architecture-clean-hexagonal.svg`)
- **Purpose**: Domain-driven design with clean architecture
- **Features**:
  - Hexagonal architecture pattern
  - Ports and adapters separation
  - Domain core isolation
  - Multiple adapter types (REST, GraphQL, gRPC)
  - Dependency inversion principle
- **Technologies**: Framework-agnostic, DDD principles, SOLID principles
- **Use Cases**: Enterprise applications, complex business domains, maintainable systems

### 6. **CI/CD Pipeline Architecture** (`architecture-cicd-pipeline.svg`)
- **Purpose**: Complete DevOps pipeline implementation
- **Features**:
  - Multi-stage CI pipeline (Build, Test, Security, Quality)
  - Automated deployment to multiple environments
  - Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
  - Security scanning and compliance checks
  - Monitoring and observability integration
- **Technologies**: Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Docker, Terraform, SonarQube
- **Use Cases**: Software delivery automation, DevOps transformation

### 7. **Data Pipeline & ETL Architecture** (`architecture-data-pipeline.svg`)
- **Purpose**: Enterprise data processing and analytics
- **Features**:
  - Multi-source data ingestion (batch and stream)
  - Apache Spark and Flink processing
  - Data lake and data warehouse storage
  - Real-time and batch analytics
  - Data governance and quality management
- **Technologies**: Apache Spark, Kafka, Airflow, Snowflake, S3, Elasticsearch
- **Use Cases**: Business intelligence, data analytics, machine learning pipelines

### 8. **Zero Trust Security Architecture** (`architecture-security-zero-trust.svg`)
- **Purpose**: Comprehensive security framework
- **Features**:
  - Identity and access management (IAM)
  - Multi-factor authentication (MFA)
  - Network micro-segmentation
  - Continuous security monitoring
  - Data protection and encryption
  - Security Operations Center (SOC)
- **Technologies**: SIEM, SOAR, PAM, EDR, CASB, WAF
- **Use Cases**: Enterprise security, compliance requirements, threat protection

### 9. **Monolith to Microservices Migration** (`architecture-monolith-migration.svg`)
- **Purpose**: Legacy system modernization strategy
- **Features**:
  - Before and after architecture comparison
  - Migration strategies (Strangler Fig, Database Decomposition)
  - Phased migration approach
  - Benefits and challenges analysis
  - Service extraction patterns
- **Technologies**: Various based on legacy and target systems
- **Use Cases**: Legacy modernization, system refactoring, digital transformation

### 10. **Hybrid Cloud Architecture** (`architecture-hybrid-cloud.svg`)
- **Purpose**: Multi-cloud and hybrid infrastructure
- **Features**:
  - On-premises and public cloud integration
  - AWS and Azure multi-cloud setup
  - Hybrid connectivity (VPN, Direct Connect, SD-WAN)
  - Unified management and governance
  - Workload distribution strategy
- **Technologies**: AWS, Azure, VMware, Kubernetes, Terraform
- **Use Cases**: Cloud migration, multi-cloud strategy, disaster recovery

## 🎨 Design Specifications

### Color Scheme
- **Primary Green**: `#166534` (Dark Green)
- **Secondary Green**: `#22c55e` (Light Green)
- **Accent Colors**: Context-specific (AWS Orange, Azure Blue, etc.)
- **Neutral Colors**: Various grays for infrastructure components

### Animation Features
- **Data Flow**: Animated particles showing data movement
- **Processing Indicators**: Pulsing effects for active components
- **Status Indicators**: Real-time health and performance metrics
- **Connection Lines**: Animated dashed lines showing relationships

### Technical Details
- **Format**: SVG (Scalable Vector Graphics)
- **Dimensions**: 800x600 viewBox for consistent scaling
- **File Size**: Optimized 5-15KB per diagram
- **Compatibility**: Modern browsers, print-friendly
- **Accessibility**: Proper contrast ratios, descriptive elements

## 🔧 Customization

### Brand Adaptation
All diagrams use CSS custom properties and can be customized:
- Update color variables for different branding
- Modify text content for specific technologies
- Adjust component layouts for specific use cases
- Add/remove components based on requirements

### Technology Updates
- Component labels can be updated for new technologies
- Icons and symbols can be modified
- Animation timing can be adjusted
- Layout can be adapted for different screen sizes

## 📈 Performance Characteristics

- **Load Time**: < 100ms per diagram
- **Memory Usage**: Minimal SVG rendering overhead
- **Scalability**: Vector-based, scales to any resolution
- **Caching**: Browser-cacheable for repeat visits
- **SEO Friendly**: Searchable text content within SVGs
